mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, file_id, original_name, storage_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, extension, md5, storage_type, bucket, access_url, thumbnail_url, business_type, business_id, group_id, uploader_id, upload_time, expire_time, is_private, download_count, status, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
